messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Two knowledge-graph relations extracted from drug information texts are given below. Decide whether they express the same meaning with the same subject/object direction, so that they can be merged into one relation without losing information.

Relation A: 'has clinical importance' defined as 'The subject drug has a clinically significant characteristic or requirement specified by the object entity.'
Example triple with A: ["Fluoxetine", "has clinical importance", "requires washout period when switching medications"]
Relation B: 'belongs to drug class' defined as 'The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.'
Example triple with B: null

Do relations A and B express the same meaning, so that every triple using A could use B instead without changing the fact it states? Answer with only "yes" or "no".
Answer:
